title: Corrected AI stock-picker design and dated amendments
chronology: Initial lock 2026-09-30; amendments 1-3 precede real model results. Amendment 4 follows the computed verdict: reporting aggregates and the omega wording threshold are post hoc, not pre-registered.
prior: Earlier lab results were seen. No numerical probability prior is specified for the corrected run. The doubling check is confirmatory, not blind, and is outside the verdict.
model_label: LSTM trained for one epoch; the earlier implementation used three epochs
label: Above own-universe median of traded return; close t+1 to t+1+h; missing only beyond the final date.
execution: Decide at close t, next-close fill; h trading days; gaps carry to resumption; missing-fill and empty sleeves are zero-interest cash; terminal liquidation charged.
cost: Half round-trip bps times one-way drift-adjusted turnover; stress changes true ends only; old-cost sensitivity charges a full-book round trip on exit.
metrics: Nominal price returns on 2008-01-03 to 2026-06-22; CAGR in calendar years; sample standard deviation; annual Sharpe sqrt(252), risk-free rate zero; drawdown from initial equity before charges.

amendments.effect: Approves design; one-epoch disclosure and code review required.
Clarifies removed-bar screen, gap boundary, cash sleeves, liquidation costs, label median and date-mean calibration.

Ticker-wide split reconstruction; security joins; raw-volume feature; float64 scores; complete window and null checks. Same-ticker resumes within 126 days or same-CIK starts within 30 days join if split-corrected ratio is between one half and two. Current identifiers remain limited.

amendments.class: POST HOC, NOT PRE-REGISTERED; results already seen
amendments.effect: Adds seed means and omega sums/ratios, plus the one-half systematic-wording cutoff; no threshold in the registered verdict changes. Historical before/after assertion execution was not recorded.

read_amendments: Amendment 3 replaces segment-level raw-price reconstruction and identity construction. Original paragraphs alone are not the effective design.

decision_rules.locked_condition: Model-containing share at least one half, or model main effect at least the setup main-effect sum, in at least two of three seeds in either variant.
Model total effect ranks first, second or third among five factors in at least two of three seeds, in either variant.
Model-containing terms at least half the setup-only terms: M >= 1/3, in at least two of three seeds.
Setup main-effect sum at least twice model main effect in every seed, both variants.
Neither earlier branch fires and the main-effects bar fails.
Neither earlier branch fires and the main-effects bar passes; wording also depends on control/scope.

control_rule: PASS only if IC 0.03 fires in both variants and IC 0 fires in neither; INDETERMINATE if IC 0 fires; otherwise FAIL.
scope_rule: Within either stock list and either variant, rank among first two of four or M at least one third in two of three seeds narrows a HOLDS statement; it does not supersede BROKEN.
null_arm: 100 draws; NULL-SRC and four registered twins plus screened-hindsight sensitivity. Report median, 5th/95th percentiles and beat shares against matched SPY.
confirmatory_not_blind: Median NULL-SRC CAGR at least twice price-only SPY CAGR, and horizon shares; outside every verdict condition.
descriptive: CAGR attribution, stress and old-cost attribution, cost/turnover arithmetic, best cells, PIT/high-cost/basket corner, IC, omega and data/gate counts. Post-hoc reporting conventions are labelled separately.
